correctness.rationale: Unique alternating maximal short-run decomposition yields G_H(z)=(pz)^r(1+B(z))/(1-A(z)B(z)), with A=sum_(j=1)^(r-1)(pz)^j and analogous B. Normalizing separates a common geometric sum of pairs of short runs and a winning-specific truncated-geometric variable; strict monotone likelihood ratios on Z_p supply a quantile coupling. Its monotone coupling achieves the absolute means lower bound for W1, and mu_r(p) is strictly increasing by its log-derivative variance. Strict bound uses p,q in (0,1); endpoint supremum not attained. Independent exact rational dynamic program for r=2..6 and multiple probabilities checked coefficient and conditional CDF order.

limitations: r>=2, equal head/tail target lengths, iid Bernoulli p strictly between 0 and 1.
